scripts.installation:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "Downloading FiveM Server..."
mkdir -p /home/container/alpine
cd /home/container/alpine

# Download the latest FiveM server build
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sSL https://changelogs-live.fivem.net/api/changelog/versions/linux/server | jq -r '.latest_download')

if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ] || [ "$DOWNLOAD_URL" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Failed to get download URL"
    exit 1
fi

curl -sSL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o server.tar.gz
tar -xzf server.tar.gz
rm -f server.tar.gz run.sh

echo "FiveM Server downloaded successfully!"
echo ""
echo "Next steps:"
echo "1. Set FIVEM_LICENSE environment variable with your server key from https://portal.cfx.re/"
echo "2. Configure txAdmin port (default: 40120) and server port (default: 30120)"
echo "3. Start the server!"

variables.name: FiveM License Key
variables.description: Your FiveM server license key from https://portal.cfx.re/

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically download and update FiveM server binaries on startup

variables.name: txAdmin Port
variables.description: Port for txAdmin web panel (cannot be 30120)

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on server (enforced by txAdmin)

variables.name: Provider Name
variables.description: Your hosting provider name (2-16 chars, shown in txAdmin warnings)

variables.name: Provider Logo URL
variables.description: Provider logo URL for txAdmin login page (224x96px max). Use {theme} for dark/light: https://example.com/logo_{theme}.png

variables.name: Quiet Mode
variables.description: Hide FXServer console output from txAdmin (recommended for GSPs)
